# netactuate_server_summary (Data Source)

Reads a Server Summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_server_summary" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose summary should be read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by the API.
